questions.stem: Purple paint is mixed using red and blue paint in the ratio $2 : 5$. If you use $300\,\text{ml}$ of blue paint, how much red paint do you need?
questions.explanation: Blue corresponds to $5$ parts, so $1$ part $= 300 \div 5 = 60\,\text{ml}$. Red is $2$ parts $= 2 \times 60 = 120\,\text{ml}$.

questions.stem: The ratio of boys to girls in a class is $4 : 3$. If there are $28$ students, how many are girls?
questions.explanation: Total parts $= 4 + 3 = 7$. One part $= 28 \div 7 = 4$ students. Girls $= 3 \times 4 = 12$.

questions.stem: Write the ratio $0.5 : 1.5 : 2$ in whole numbers in its simplest form.
questions.explanation: Multiply all parts by $2$ to remove decimals: $1 : 3 : 4$. This is already in simplest form since there is no common factor.
